description: Read UTF-8 text from a Dropbox file up to 10 MB, returning chunks at character boundaries. PDF and Office documents are not supported.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to return (default 4000 to fit chat responses, min 4, max 1000000)

start_byte.description: Zero-based byte offset (default 0). Use the previous result's end_byte to continue.

name: dropbox_read_file
